title: Seal eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water line splash -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='7' fill='#1e4d7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#2e7bb8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='17' fill='#9aa7b5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#d7dee6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='17' fill='#9aa7b5'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c3ccd6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#26323d'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#26323d'/>
  <circle cx='43.9' cy='34.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.9' cy='34.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#2a3640'/>
  <!-- mouth line -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 49 54 47' stroke='#5c6b78' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fish snack in mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='8' ry='3.4' fill='#f0a03a'/>
  <path d='M58 50 L63 46.5 L63 53.5 Z' fill='#e07d1e'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='49' r='1' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <!-- front flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='60' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#8a97a4' transform='rotate(18 26 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='60' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#8a97a4' transform='rotate(-18 74 60)'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#5c6b78'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#5c6b78'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#5c6b78'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#5c6b78'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='none' stroke='#7fc4f0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='none' stroke='#7fc4f0' stroke-width='1.1'/>
</svg>
